comment: Single source of truth for the SPFN Mobile module graph. Canonical format: exactly one module object per line inside "modules". Consumed by tools/validate/validate.sh and tools/cocoapods-compat/generate-podspec.sh.
notes: The Swift/Android name asymmetry (SPFNPersistence <-> spfn-sync) is carried verbatim from the approved topology artifact section 3. Renaming either side is an UNRESOLVED decision, not a scaffold choice.
Dependency edges are a Step 1 scaffold proposal derived from the layered design; they carry no implementation and may be revised in Step 2.
